entries.object: declaraçao ya mutchifutchi tcheswe ya kusakula tcha athu ngwe ipema uikha ha kuheta kuli athu eswe ku ifutchi yeswe

spans.text: Ye Asembeleia Yeswe Hakusa ye declaraçao ya mutchifutchi tcheswe ya kusakula tcha athu ngwe ipema uikha ha kuheta kuli athu eswe ku ifutchi yeswe, hangta athu eswe nyi jhe milimo,jipwe mu espiritu, alikolueze, ku ulongueso ua vumbi ya kusakula nyi kutuaka, kuluthue mu membo nyi kusuku, tche kunyinguika tcha kusa yuma kuswe nyi zango hali athu jha mue muihunda hakamuihi, tchize ngue yfutchi aysa hali akua ululi.
